description: This file defines a custom GlideModule implementation called GlideConfiguration, which customizes the global configuration for the Glide image loading library in an Android project. It mainly overrides the decode format to prioritize higher quality images.

classes.name: GlideConfiguration
classes.description: A class implementing GlideModule to configure global Glide settings, such as image decode format.

methods.name: applyOptions
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the image decode format to ARGB_8888 for higher quality images.

methods.name: registerComponents
methods.description: Override of the method for registering components, left empty in this implementation.
